definition: A normalized family-level LCA database, dataset, software, format, schema, platform, method, project, organization, or related resource.
counting_rule: One stable Asset ID per reviewed family; releases and distributions are separate records.

definition: A database or dataset family counted in the narrow answer to how many LCA databases have been publicly identified.
counting_rule: Database Scope.Working count status equals Core working count; a portal, repository or platform is not counted again as a database family merely because it distributes data.

definition: The core database families plus reviewed repositories, platforms and libraries that bear or distribute LCA data but are not themselves counted as additional database families.
counting_rule: Database Scope.Extended data-bearing count equals Yes; use this scope to describe the data-access ecosystem, not as a synonym for the database-family count.

definition: A publicly accessed source supporting one or more fields or relationships.
counting_rule: One Evidence ID per registered source record; not a unique-URL count.

definition: A verified public version or lifecycle milestone for an asset.
counting_rule: Milestone record; intervening releases may exist.

definition: A specific data package or access route connecting a database release, schema/profile, and consuming software.
counting_rule: One Distribution ID per reviewed package/route statement.

definition: A reviewed canonical label and broader family assigned to equivalent public schema, profile, package, or software-native exchange labels.
counting_rule: Merge only curated synonyms; preserve every source label in schema_profile_original and keep compound or version-specific profiles distinct.

definition: A directed, evidence-bearing claim between a source and target asset.
counting_rule: Retain direction, status, constraints, and validation question.

definition: An implemented or studied mapping/conversion between named source and target formats or schemas.
counting_rule: Must identify source, target, direction, project/tool, and claimed or tested status.

definition: The specific schema, exchange format, software importer, software-internal model, workflow or reference list at one end of a mapping artifact.
counting_rule: Align synonyms within the same endpoint kind, retain the original label, and never merge a software product with its schema merely because they share a brand name.

definition: A dated recheck of every database-scope canonical route and its current-version evidence.
counting_rule: Separate explicit public updates, retained evidence-linked values, exact versions that remain unconfirmed, and routes whose automated check was unresolved.

definition: Data whose public licence permits reuse under stated conditions.
counting_rule: Do not infer from zero price or public download alone.

definition: Software whose source code is released under an open-source licence.
counting_rule: Assess separately from data-access rights.

definition: A statement that a tool can import, export, or otherwise use a format or package.
counting_rule: Record direction, versions, evidence, and claimed/tested status.

definition: The latest date included in a versioned review package.
counting_rule: All counts and conclusions must display the cutoff.

definition: An assessment of public evidence strength for a reviewed asset record.
counting_rule: It does not rate the quality of the asset itself.

definition: A questionnaire, stakeholder-list, or search result that may point to an asset but is not yet a verified asset record.
counting_rule: Leads are not included in verified asset counts until publicly substantiated and deduplicated.

definition: A named software product that publicly states it performs life cycle assessment, calculates product carbon footprints, or directly implements standardized PCF exchange.
counting_rule: Count one reviewed product family once; do not include a general corporate-only accounting platform, consultancy, or service listing without an explicit qualifying product function.

definition: How a reviewed PCF/LCA product is delivered or used, such as an application/platform, sector workflow, interoperability service, or API/library/model.
counting_rule: Assign one product type independently of its functions, sector, standards, and provider identity.

definition: One aligned headline function for a PCF/LCA software product; LCA and PCF modelling are grouped as one modelling/calculation function.
counting_rule: Assign one controlled primary function and retain finer distinctions as multi-valued functional capabilities.

definition: An evidence-linked function a product can perform, using aligned labels while retaining source wording separately.
counting_rule: A product may have several capabilities; do not mix capabilities with product type, sector, or standard/network association.

definition: Evidence that a software product is listed by or states compatibility with a standard, network, or authoritative directory.
counting_rule: Treat WBCSD PACT association as interoperability evidence and provenance, not as a software category, calculation function, or quality rating.

definition: A public evidence-linked relationship between a software product and a company, institution, public body, community, or publicly credited individual acting as owner, developer, or operator/maintainer.
counting_rule: Create only roles supported by public evidence; never copy one role into another or use an unresolved product name as the actor. Missing roles remain absent and unresolved labels are retained in software_role_gaps.

definition: A listing encountered in a documented software discovery stream and assigned a promotion, existing-match, or exclusion decision.
counting_rule: Candidate appearances are not asset counts; deduplicate across directories before promotion and retain exclusions with a reason.
